description: Picodata topology and options: version, tiers, sharding, memtx memory.

fields.description: auto = settings sized from the machine, role, topology and workload (every value the run used is in its configs); stock = the engine's own defaults. A key set in the config wins over auto.
fields.name: tuning
fields.title: Tuning

fields.description: Picodata series (YY.MINOR); packages come from download.picodata.io.
fields.name: version
fields.title: Picodata version

fields.description: Cluster tiers; one of them must be named `default` — the tier an instance lands in when it names none.
Key under cluster.tier; instances join a tier by this name.
fields.name: name
fields.title: Tier name

fields.description: How many picodata instances stroppy-cloud starts in this tier; must divide evenly into replicasets.
fields.name: instances
fields.title: Instances

fields.description: Instances per replicaset in this tier (Picodata default 1).
fields.name: replication_factor
fields.title: Replication factor

fields.description: Whether instances of this tier take part in the cluster raft vote (Picodata default true).
fields.name: can_vote
fields.title: Raft voter

fields.description: Sharding buckets for this tier; unset falls back to cluster.default_bucket_count.
fields.name: bucket_count
fields.title: Bucket count

fields.description: Within a replicaset: async = the leader does not wait for replicas, sync = it does (Picodata default async).
fields.name: replication_mode
fields.title: Replication mode

fields.description: 26.2 only: write = a commit waits for the WAL write, fsync = for its fsync too. Empty = fsync under tuning auto, Picodata's own write under stock; 25.3 and 26.1 always write without fsync.
fields.name: wal_mode
fields.title: WAL mode

fields.name: tiers
fields.title: Tiers

fields.description: cluster.default_bucket_count — buckets a tier gets when it sets none of its own (Picodata default 3000).
fields.name: default_bucket_count
fields.title: Default bucket count

fields.description: Picodata instances started on one machine (one memtx transaction thread each); machines = ceil(instances / this). Replicas of a replicaset never share a machine.
fields.name: instances_per_machine
fields.title: Instances per machine

fields.description: instance.memtx.memory per instance. Empty = sized from the machine's RAM under tuning auto, 2 GB under stock; Picodata's own default of 64 MB only fits a smoke test.
fields.name: memtx_memory_mb
fields.title: memtx memory

fields.description: Maximum VDBE instructions per local SQL plan; 0 = no limit. Picodata's own default is 45000, which stops full-scan queries such as workload validation.
fields.name: sql_vdbe_opcode_max
fields.title: SQL instruction limit

fields.description: Queries one instance runs at once (Picodata default 50; 26.1 and later). Empty = 1.5 × peak virtual users per SQL endpoint, at least 50, under tuning auto.
fields.name: sql_runtime_concurrency_max
fields.title: Concurrent SQL queries

fields.description: Prepared statements in the LRU cache of a storage instance (Picodata default 50). Empty = 200 under tuning auto.
fields.name: sql_storage_cache_count_max
fields.title: Storage plan cache entries

fields.description: sql_storage_cache_size_max, the LRU cache of prepared statements on a storage instance (Picodata default 5 MB). Empty = 32 MB under tuning auto.
fields.name: sql_storage_cache_size_max_mb
fields.title: Storage plan cache size

fields.description: Rows a virtual table of one query may collect from the storages (Picodata default 5000). Empty = 50000 under tuning auto, so large validation and batch queries do not stop at the limit.
fields.name: sql_motion_row_max
fields.title: Rows per motion

fields.description: HAProxy instances spreading pgproto clients over the instances of the default tier.
fields.name: haproxy
fields.title: HAProxy nodes

fields.description: Expose the PostgreSQL wire-protocol listener; stroppy drives Picodata through it.
fields.name: pgproto
fields.title: PostgreSQL protocol

rules.message: a tier's instances must divide evenly into replicasets of replication_factor
at least one tier must be able to vote, otherwise the cluster raft never elects a leader
the fsync WAL mode requires Picodata 26.2
HAProxy fronts the pgproto listener, so pgproto must be on
